newsitem.title: USA: Calif. tax board sponsors pet adoption tax break.
newsitem.headline: Calif. tax board sponsors pet adoption tax break.

text.p: The California Board of Equalization said on Wednesday it was sponsoring legislation that would provide a state sales tax exemption for people who adopt a pet.
Johan Klehs, chair of the Board of Equalization, said the board would announce on Thursday the introduction of legislation to enact the so-called "Pet Adoption Sales Tax Relief Act of 1997."
The legislation would provide for an exemption from state sales tax for the fees and costs incurred when adopting a pet from a non-profit agency or local government animal shelter.
Further details about the proposal were not immediately available. A press conference was set for Thursday.
